• For the week ending August 5:
    • The price at the Title Transfer Facility (TTF) in Europe averaged $19.14/MMBtu, $1.03/MMBtu lower than the previous week.
    • The Japan-Korea Marker (JKM) price averaged $21.23/MMBtu, $0.37/MMBtu lower than the previous week.
    • Compared with the week ending February 25, before LNG deliveries via the Strait of Hormuz were disrupted, this week's TTF and JKM prices are up by 74% and 99%, respectively.
